acceptance_criteria.criterion: Navigating to #/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/branch-switch renders Step 1 with a text input for branch name and a selectable list of branch suggestions fetched from GET /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/branches (using the suggestions array).
Selecting a suggestion or typing a branch name and clicking 'Next' advances to Step 2, which shows a table with one row per repository, each with a text input pre-filled with the chosen branch.

Each repository row in Step 2 has a <select> dropdown populated from branches[repoId] (the per-repo BranchInfo[] array), with the Step 1 branch in a separate option group; selecting a dropdown option copies the value into the text input.

Clicking 'Confirm' in Step 2 calls POST /api/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid/branches/switch with { assignments: Record<repoId, branchName> } and renders Step 3 with per-repo results showing success, conflict, or error.
Conflict results (where conflict === true) display a message instructing the user to resolve conflicts manually.
The 'Done' button in Step 3 navigates back to #/projects/:id/workspaces/:wid.
